player_prompt.intro: Kuna Player {player_id} a cikin {max_rounds} zagaye na wasan Kuhn Poker. Dokokin Wasanni: - Kuhn Poker yana amfani da katunan katin 3-katin tare da J, Q, K (J mafi ƙanƙanci, K mafi girma) - Kowane ɗan wasa yana amfani da kwakwalwan kwamfuta {ante} kuma yana karɓar katin 1 a kowane zagaye (lura cewa ana ba da katunan ba tare da sauyawa ba, don haka ba za ku iya samun katin ɗaya kamar abokin hamayyarku ba). - Wasan ya ci gaba don zagaye {max_rounds} - Mai kunnawa tare da mafi yawan kwakwalwan kwamfuta bayan duk zagaye ya ci nasara Dokokin Aiki: - '[check]': Wuce ba tare da yin fare ba (kawai idan babu fare a kan tebur) - '[bet]': Sanya guntu 1 zuwa tukunya (kawai idan babu fare a kan tebur) - '[call]': daidaita cinikin abokin hamayya ta hanyar ƙara 1 zuwa tukunya - '[fold]': Ka ba da hannunka kuma bari abokin hamayyarka ya ci tukunya

init_round.round_start: ### Fara zagaye {current_round} daga cikin {max_rounds} zagaye. Katin ku shine: '{player_card}'

invalid_move.wrong_format: Dole ne a yi aiki [Check], [Bet], [Call], ko [Fold].

action.submit_move: Dan wasa {player_id}, ya gabatar da motsi: '[{move}]'.
action.round_summary: {reason} Sakamakon yanzu: Mai kunnawa 0: "{player_0_chips}"; Mai kunnawa 1: "{player_1_chips}"

showdown.showdown_summary: Nunawa: Mai kunnawa {winner} {winner_card} ya doke Mai kunnawa {loser} {loser_card}. Mai kunnawa {winner} ya ci tukunyar kwakwalwan {pot_value}.

outcome.draw: A ƙarshen zagaye na {max_rounds}, 'yan wasan biyu suna da kwakwalwan kwamfuta iri ɗaya.
outcome.winner_player0: Mai kunnawa 0 ya ci nasara ta hanyar samun ƙarin kwakwalwan kwamfuta a ƙarshen duk zagaye {max_rounds}.
outcome.winner_player1: Mai kunnawa 1 ya ci nasara ta hanyar samun ƙarin kwakwalwan kwamfuta a ƙarshen duk zagaye {max_rounds}.
